description: This PHP source file defines the SubProcess class, a Drupal migration process plugin that processes arrays of associative arrays through their own processing pipeline, supporting nested processing, dynamic key transformation, and source data inclusion.

classes.name: SubProcess
classes.description: A Drupal migration process plugin that processes arrays of associative arrays through their own process pipeline, allowing nested processing, dynamic keying, and source data inclusion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SubProcess plugin with configuration options, setting defaults for include_source and source_key.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Processes each element of the input array by creating a new Row, applying the nested process pipeline, and collecting the results with optional key transformation.

methods.name: transformKey
methods.description: Transforms the key for each processed item using the specified process pipeline, returning the new key.

methods.name: multiple
methods.description: Indicates that this plugin supports processing multiple items simultaneously, returning TRUE.
